cands.bio: Republican elected to Alabama State Senate District 15 in 2026. Former public school teacher and pharmacist who earned an MBA and a Master of Public Health at UAB. Founded Solutions Infusion Therapy in 2003 and ran it for about 20 years. Defeated incumbent Dan Roberts in the 2026 primary.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Scott Ortis was born or raised, or when he moved to Alabama. He has held no prior elected office, so there is no voting or legislative record to review. His campaign site lists general goals such as cutting taxes and regulations, term limits, career- and college-readiness in schools, and fighting waste and fraud. It does not state positions on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by outside buyers, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, gun laws, abortion, or school vouchers and teacher pay. We found no documented public stance on data centers or development, no controversies, and no foreign ties. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. His Wikipedia page contains only a one-line description.

qual.background: Taught in public schools, worked as a pharmacist, led operations at a regional healthcare company, and founded and ran Solutions Infusion Therapy from 2003 for about 20 years. Holds an MBA and a Master of Public Health. No prior elected office is listed.
qual.why: Two decades as a business founder and manager place him in the middle band. There is no prior legislative service and no policy or budget career on record.
